prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one 64x64-native world sprite for Space Station 13, transparent background.
Inputs: image 1 is the EDIT TARGET (current biomass basin); image 2 is a CONTACT SHEET of actual in-game xenomorph castes for PIXEL TECHNIQUE and PALETTE reference (ignore its old generator in the bottom right); image 3 is IN-GAME CONTEXT for scale/readability (do not copy its floor, red arrows or other objects).
Primary request: REDRAW the target to look hand-sprited by the same artist as the Drone, Praetorian and Carrier in image 2. The existing generator looks like a high-resolution glossy fantasy illustration reduced into noisy pixels. Correct that mismatch.
Keep: low broad rooted organic acid BASIN, hollow center, several curved chitin rim-spines, roughly the same overall 2x2 footprint and viewing angle. Static shell only; vapor is animated separately, do NOT draw smoke.
Change: use the castes' near-black blue/gray chitin, very dark restrained plum flesh, thin sharp BLACK outer contours and tiny broken cool-gray edge highlights. Replace the big shiny pink fleshy balls with small dark segmented ribbed side organs partly covered by chitin. Make the horns/ribs organically xenomorphic rather than polished fantasy spikes. The acid must be a SMALL muted olive-yellow-green surface with just a few pale pixels, not a luminous neon pond. No broad silver highlights, pink gloss or smooth gradients.
Pixel medium: actually design at a logical 64x64 resolution, with about 20-28 flat colors, deliberate solid 1-3-pixel clusters, clean single-pixel outlines and restrained sparse highlights like the local castes. Output enlarged with perfectly crisp square blocks if necessary. No soft brush, anti-aliasing, subpixel texture, multicolor speckle, bloom, rim glow, rendered 3D shading or photorealism. Enough clean transparent padding for a complete isolated sprite, no ground shadow, floor, labels, UI, reference sheet, other sprites or multiple frames.
Readability: dark silhouette and thin edged ribs should fit alongside the native castes, with only a subdued acid center distinguishing its function. Preserve natural asymmetry; not a metal machine, skull or literal human power station.
references: generator_style_castes_reference.png (native caste frames; donor attribution retained)
User-provided in-game screenshot, reference only; not redistributed.
packing: 64x64, no dithering, binary transparency; chitin/flesh ramps from Drone/Praetorian, acid ramp from Spitter in big_xenos.dmi.
